In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms involved in the activation and proliferation of oval cells in the adult rat liver.
the role of growth factors in the proliferation of hepatic ductal cells and the expansion of these cells in the liver acinus.
the mechanisms of oval cell activation, which is an essential prerequisite for the regeneration of the liver.
